questions.question: What did King Darius find when he searched the records?
options: Nothing of any use to the matter
A treaty with the kings of the region
The decree of Cyrus authorizing the temple
A map of the old city of Jerusalem
questions.answer: The decree of Cyrus authorizing the temple

questions.question: What did Darius command Tattenai to do?
options: Let the work continue and pay its costs from royal taxes
Tear down what had already been built so far
Halt all the building until further notice from the court
Arrest the leaders and send them to Babylon
questions.answer: Let the work continue and pay its costs from royal taxes

questions.question: The temple was completed and dedicated with joy, and they kept the Passover.
The house was finished in the sixth year of the reign of _____ the king.
The work prospered through the prophesying of Haggai and _____.
